FROM IDEA TO ACTION

Your story, in three little steps.

  1. Draw your world. Pick Draw or Line, an ink color, and a brush size.
  2. Meet your character. Add a stick figure. Use Move to drag its body, hands, and feet.
  3. Make it move. Select a layer, press Record, and puppet it while the other layers play. Stop and drag your take onto a channel.
  4. Build your story. Use Play whole story to play every scene in order. Export video includes every scene and recorded voice.
  5. Record voices. Press Record voice and allow microphone access when your browser asks. Place voice takes on the Voice channel.
  6. Trim a take. Select a clip, drag its ends, or edit Trim in and Trim out.

Every take stays in the Recordings tray. Drag takes to layer channels and slide them to set their timing. Clips on different layers play together; clips on the same layer cannot overlap. Arrow keys move the selected character or item.
